findings.title: Actual shopper alarm can leave expired recovery bodies behind unrelated or earlier remote maintenance
findings.required_correction: Run a bounded local strip-all phase for all expired/retired recovery payloads before unrelated external maintenance or any recovery child's remote await. Preserve exact cleanup references and truthful terminal reasons until acknowledged continuation; an unavailable remote service must not block independently authorized local raw expiry.
minimal_cases: Live tracking consent, an external session projection whose provider-copy deadline has expired, and an expired admitted recovery operation. Fail the projection KV read/publication: alarm exits before recoveryBody deletion.

Two expired admitted recovery operations. Hold the first operation's R2 or child cleanup await: the second operation's expired raw body remains present although its local expiry is already independently known.

findings.title: Frozen credit attribution loses the selected decision's original online lifetime
findings.required_correction: Preserve and enforce the selected decisions' immutable online retention dependencies in frozen attribution, credit effects and physical plan cleanup, combining compatible copied cohorts at their earliest lifetime and refusing incompatible/expired proof. Keep original-time arithmetic, stable effect IDs, partial-credit idempotency and reset fences; do not recalculate attribution or renew its lifetime.
minimal_cases: Decision online expiry T+100; later outcome online expiry T+200 under the same policy. Prepare immutable multi-destination attribution at T+50, let one destination fail, recreate/retry at T+150. The saved plan still retains copied decision attribution and the missing credit remains eligible until T+200.
An await during preparation or credit delivery crosses the selected decision's earlier deadline while the outcome/consent remain live; current final guards cannot detect the dropped dependency.

findings.title: Policy-unset desired state still activates a DLQ consumer known to refuse every unknown case
findings.required_correction: Hold or refuse activation of an intake consumer lacking its explicit capture/disposal prerequisites, independently of producer opt-in. Preserve required environment declarations and already-managed readers/erasers, do not invent policy values, and retain W08 protected receipt/current-state/both-queue maintenance safety. Operational finite-retention limits must remain explicit.
minimal_cases: Promote desired state with LEDGER_RECOVERY_ENABLED='false' and valid source/DLQ configuration but no unknown policy. An unrecognized source poison message reaches the newly attached DLQ consumer, cannot be quarantined, and exhausts the consumer without a retained case or authorized terminal disposition.

findings.title: One unrelated unreadable quarantine case prevents valid later expiry and erasure
findings.required_correction: Isolate per-case failures within the existing bounded scan/checkpoint mechanism so independently authenticated cases can be processed while bad proof remains held and unresolved. Do not report complete erasure, discard uncertainty, lose retry discovery or authorize deletion of the invalid case merely to advance the scan.
minimal_cases: First listed case has an invalid HMAC or a persistent per-key read failure; a later correctly authenticated case is expired. Scheduled cleanup repeatedly fails before deleting the valid expired payload.
The first bad case is unrelated to a subject being erased; a later authenticated case contains that subject. Current subject erasure stops before processing the valid case.
